notes.title: v2.0.9 - 2023.2.26
notes.content:
v2.0.9 - 2023.2.26
- The descriptions of some achievements have been made clearer
- Fixed a bug where some achievements were triggered incorrectly

v2.0.8 - 2023.2.24
- Reworked the effect of the Action Figure
- Wishmaker just got smarter
- Fixed some text mistake

v2.0.7 - 2023.2.23
- Fixed the bug that the Max Goods option does not take effect when continuing the game
- Fixed an issue where some achievements were triggered in the wrong way
- Fixed some wrong text

v2.0.6 - 2023.2.23
- Fixed some UI interface bugs
- Fixed the wrong settlement order of rich merchants
- Bullied the original captain a bit, now the original captain will not be lazy
